falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 lows (~4950) would invalidate the 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held above 5100; this would confirm a lower low structure and reject the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at ~28; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic escalation beyond the referenced pattern, proving this is not a comparable bottom but rather a breakdown into deeper risk-off

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.75% while SPX is simultaneously below 5200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession bid in bonds concurrent with equity weakness, invalidating the 'bottom' signal which requires rates stability/equity divergence to resolve; it would confirm macro deterioration rather than a tradable low

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
